samples.summary: Design doc claims setData/removeData use the new `recalculateWithUnblocked` helper, but they still open-code the pattern
samples.evidence: calculator.md:70-77 says "it consumes the registration (`consumeSpillBlocker`) and hands the anchor to `recalculateWithUnblocked` ... `setData`, `removeData`, `moveRangeTo`, cut-`paste`, `mergeSelection`, and `autofill` all follow it". In sheet.ts, `setData` (lines 1132-1143) and `removeData` (lines 1213-1222) still build the dependants map and inject the anchor inline; only moveRangeTo (2529), cut-paste (2271), autofill (2771) and mergeSelection (4461) call the helper. The lessons file also states "the durable answer was one `recalculateWithUnblocked` helper the five paths share" — the two oldest paths were not migrated, so the documented single-source-of-truth is not real and the duplication the helper was meant to remove persists in the two canonical paths.

samples.summary: Row/column insert & delete (`shiftCells`) is a clearing/shifting path that neither consumes nor remaps spill-blocker registrations, so the newly documented model-wide contract is incomplete
samples.evidence: calculator.md:70-72 now declares "every gesture that erases or overwrites a cell owes the blocked anchor a fresh attempt". `shiftCells` (sheet.ts:1282-1330) shifts dimensions, styles, merges, conditional formats, data validations, filter and hidden state, but never touches `this.spillBlockers` (grep for spillBlockers shows no reference in that function). Deleting the row containing a blocker leaves the anchor on a stale `#REF!`, and inserting rows leaves blocker keys pointing at srefs that have moved. Either the doc's universal claim should be narrowed or this path should join the contract.

samples.summary: The new 'ghosts are derived and never travel' invariant is applied only in `moveRangeTo`; cut-paste of a spill block still leaves source ghosts and plants their literal values at the destination
samples.evidence: calculator.md:77-80 states spill ghosts are derived cells that must not be carried. `moveRangeTo` implements this via `staleGhosts` (sheet.ts:2387-2394, 2446). The cut-paste path in the same delta only adds blocker consumption (2261) and still skips any source cell with `spillAnchor` (2259: `if (sourceCell?.spillAnchor) continue;`), so cutting a spilled range leaves orphaned read-only ghosts naming an anchor that is no longer there, while the pasted grid contains their values as plain user data. Same defect class as the one this delta fixed for drag-move, left inconsistent between two sibling gestures.

samples.summary: Production method `bindRefusalNotices` extracted purely to give a test a private seam; the test then drives private members with a fabricated `this`
samples.evidence: worksheet.ts:846-852 documents the extraction as "Kept out of `initialize` so the refusal-to-message path can be exercised without booting a whole grid", and test/view/worksheet-notice.test.ts:11-27 reaches the method via `Worksheet.prototype as unknown as {...}` and calls both `setOnNotice` and `bindRefusalNotices` with a hand-made `ctx` object. Exporting `refusalMessage` (worksheet.ts:98) — currently module-private — or testing through the public `setOnNotice`/`Sheet.setOnRefusal` pair would be the natural seam and would not couple the test to private field names (`onNoticeCallback`).
